newsitem.title: USA: Radiant Systems files for shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Radiant Systems files for shr offering.

text.p: Radiant Systems Inc said on Friday it has filed a Registration Statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the offering of 3,075,000 common shares.
Of the shares to be offered, 2,500,000 will be sold by the company and 575,000 are to be offered by certain selling shareholders, Radiant said.
Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and The Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc are managing the offering.
The proceeds of the offering will be utilized to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including possible strategic acquisitions and working capital.
The selling shareholder could not immediately be identified.
As of the end of the company's first quarter, it had about 13 million shares outstanding.
